class.name: TamaServerCurvedLaserConfig
class.brief_description: A Resource that configures the appearance of a curved (trail-based) laser type.
class.description:
[b]TamaServerCurvedLaserConfig[/b] defines the visual properties for a curved laser type registered in [TamaBulletRegistry] under the [member TamaBulletRegistry.objects] dictionary.
Curved lasers are rendered as a ribbon trail: the laser's head moves through space each frame and leaves behind a chain of trail segments. The ribbon is drawn as a triangle strip that tapers at tip and tail. Collision is a CPU point-to-segment test against the full trail, with an AABB early-out for performance.
Curved lasers can run TamaScript [code]act[/code] blocks and respond to [code]chdir[/code], [code]chspd[/code], [code]chrotspd[/code], [code]chpos[/code], and [code]vanish[/code] statements. They can also [code]fire[/code] bullets from their [code]act[/code] block; the spawn position defaults to the laser's current head position.
[b]Signals:[/b] hits are reported via [signal TamaManager.curved_laser_hit].

members.member: Width of the laser ribbon in pixels.
Number of trail nodes retained in the circular buffer. Higher values produce a longer visible trail at the cost of more geometry per laser. Minimum 2.

Animated texture used to render the laser ribbon. UV coordinates run from 0 (tip) to 1 (tail) along the V axis and 0–1 across the width (U axis). The [member TamaAnimatedTexture.blend_mode] of this texture is applied to all lasers of this type.
Maximum number of simultaneously active lasers of this type. Spawns beyond this limit are silently dropped.
Distance in pixels past the screen edge before the laser's head triggers recycling. Overridden by [member TamaManager.global_out_of_bounds_margin] when that value is ≥ 0.
